I apologise for the delay. My contractor has been unresponsive. I am finding a replacement. Please bear with me.
It is already affecting my daily routine. I had to move my furniture away from the affected area. I expect this to be resolved by end of August or I will have to escalate this formally.
I understand your frustration. However I would like to remind you that the lease terms state that tenants are responsible for servicing aircon units. This is a maintenance issue on your end.

That is not accurate. The dripping is due to a faulty installation, not lack of servicing. I had an independent technician look at it and he confirmed the drainage pipe was improperly routed from the start. This is a landlord responsibility.
I disagree with that assessment. I have photos from before you moved in showing the unit was in perfect condition. I will not be accepting liability for this.
I have the technician report in writing. If you continue to refuse to act I will be filing a formal complaint with HDB. This is not how a landlord should treat a tenant.
Given the breakdown in communication and the ongoing dispute, I do not think this tenancy arrangement is working out. I will be initiating a termination request.
